title: PWM Generator
text: Generate pulse width modulated signal or waveform, 1 input, 1 output, {Carrier counter} sets Carrier counter strategy; {Timer period (s)} sets the pWM period, {Phase delay (s)} and {Sample time} sets the block sample time 5e-5. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Carrier counter
params.values: Carrier counter strategy Up (default) | Down | Up-Down
